Demonstrate in-orbit reconfiguration and the benefits of modular satellite assembly with off-the-shelf components through MA61C, SPiN’s universal adapter.

Description

SPiN -1 will demonstrate in-orbit reconfiguration and the benefits of modular satellite assembly with off-the-shelf components through MA61C, SPiN’s universal adapter.

The mission is carried out in partnership with Telespazio Germany GmbH, Hyperion Technologies B.V., Crystalspace, NewSpace Systems, and the Technische Universität München, who provided essential hardware and software to the mission. 
Notes

Was planned to be on Transporter-3, but ride has been delayed due to a leak discovered in the Sherpa-LTC propulsion system.
